findings.obs_text: Pride and the thoughts go together in Psa 10:4 (in the pride of his face the wicked's thoughts deny God), Luk 1:51 (the proud are scattered in their inner reasonings) and 2Cor 10:5 (every lofty opinion against the knowledge of God is pulled down and the thoughts taken captive). In Jam 1:26 the one who thinks himself religious has a worthless religion.
findings.grounds: In the pride of his face the wicked does not seek him

findings.obs_text: The thought is given in an answer or reply in Gen 31:31, Exo 2:14, Est 4:13, Job 32:6, Job 32:17, Dan 4:19, Luk 5:22 and Luk 13:2: a person explains or corrects a thought in speech. In Job 20:2 the thoughts themselves answer Zophar.

In 2Cor 9:5 Paul thought it needful that the promised gift be ready: the judgment serves the promise. In Num 11:12 and Heb 11:11 promise and swearing stand with conceive in its bodily sense: Moses did not conceive the people the Lord swore to, and Sarah counted faithful the one who promised.

In 2Ki 20:19 and Isa 39:8 Hezekiah thinks there will be peace in his days: the thought rests on his own peace. In Mat 10:34 and Luk 12:51 the hearers are not to think Jesus came to bring peace: the false thought is corrected by a sword and division.
findings.grounds: Do not think that I have come to bring peace

findings.obs_text: In Job 12:5 the thought of one at ease is ready with contempt for those whose feet slip. In 2Cor 9:5 Paul judged it needful that the gift be ready as a willing gift.
findings.grounds: it is ready for those whose feet slip
